cards.review_notes: The Day Camp schedule states ages 8-12, but the introduction says camps are open to ages 12-19 and those under 13 must be day campers only. The Day Camp block also says '5 Day Overnight Camp'; type follows the Day Camp name and day-camper pricing. Confirm eligibility and format with the provider. Baseball and softball are described as separate weeks, but no dates are provided, so no session rows can be created. Prices use the 2026-27 heading as their year context.

cards.name: Outdoor Camp
cards.description: Campers receive baseball or softball instruction, play live games, and compete in outdoor challenges including canoe racing, fishing, archery, and a mud run. Campers stay in on-site log cabins.

prices.label: Teammate discount: 2 or more players placed on the same team

lunch.text: Food will be catered in to the camp and three meals a day will be provided.

cards.review_notes: The Outdoor Camp schedule states ages 13-18, while the introduction allows ages 12-19 with campers under 13 restricted to day attendance. Confirm whether 19-year-olds are eligible. The schedule specifies five days; the About page calls it one week. Baseball and softball are described as separate weeks, but dates are not provided. Prices use the 2026-27 heading as their year context. Registration requires emailing athlete@bigleaguecamp.com for a registration form.
